evidence.clarity: 1440 and 390: h1 'Counted by two. Signed by two. Written down once.' plus lede 'Tallyhall keeps the books for churches and small charities...' and CTA 'Start your free 60-day trial' state what, who and next step in the first screen.
evidence.fit: Primary CTAs (header, hero, closing) all href https://tallyhall.example/trial as the brief specifies; UK/US toggle switches currency, 'Cheques'/'Checks' and dates; 'It isn't a payment processor' section; committee Q&A plus a working 'Print a summary for the committee' button (window.print with a dedicated @media print summary). Second audience gets a real path.
evidence.distinctiveness: Ruled analysis-pad hero background, struck-through ledger 'was/now' table, double red underline on totals, drawn signatures. The phone-mockup demo is a familiar device-frame pattern, but the content is product-specific.
evidence.proof: 1440: phone count demo visible in first screen with +/- steppers; tapped 'Finish count, ask both to sign', signed as Ruth and Sam, ledger row '19 Oct ... £1,165.85' appeared with both names. Arithmetic checks: initial £1,345.85 = sum of lines; statement £550.00 / $675.00 sums correctly. But only note/coin counts are editable; envelopes and cheques are fixed.
evidence.craft: Single 38 KB file, system font stack, no requests, no console errors (probe and my own run at 1440 with network routes aborted). But: axe color-contrast x2 (progress step labels #69728a on #eef1ec, 4.21:1 at 11.52px); 6 text elements at 11.52px; many hard-coded hex values (#5A6378 repeated ~10 times, inline style attributes) outside the :root tokens; demo rows built by innerHTML string concat and the whole demo is empty (total '£0.00', no rows) with JS disabled.
evidence.mobile: 390 and 320: no horizontal overflow, hero stacks cleanly, CTA full width. But the counting artifact starts at about y=790 at 390, below the first screen; stepper buttons measure 28x28 (14 targets under 44px at 390); nav links are display:none under 760px with no menu replacement; after the second signature on 390 the page scroll-jumps so the 'Posted to the ledger' message sits above the viewport (top -72px) while focus lands on 'Count again'.
evidence.honesty: Statement carries a 'Sample' tag; demo caption 'A working sample of the counting screen. Names and amounts are made up.' is present but sits below the phone, so at 390 it appears only after the whole artifact. No invented proof: '40 congregations', no names, no figures, matching the brief.
evidence.interaction: Keyboard: Tab order skip link > nav > CTAs > currency toggle (aria-pressed) > steppers > Finish count; focus ring 3px solid ink at every stop. Focus moves to 'Sign as Ruth', then 'Sign as Sam', then to 'Count again' after posting. Gaps: after the second signature the focused button becomes display:none and document.activeElement is BODY for ~1.4 s; the sign pane has no way back to correct the count (only switching currency resets it); minus clamps silently at 0 with no message; no free-entry input so no empty/paste states exist. Reduced motion: signature and row animations set to none and post delay drops to 300 ms.
evidence.copy: Plain, specific nouns from the treasurer's world: 'before the bags go in the safe', 'Nobody types the figures in again on Monday night', 'Struck through with a single line, the way a ledger correction should be'. Buttons say what happens ('Finish count, ask both to sign', 'Print a summary for the committee').
evidence.first_screen: 1440: headline, lede, CTA and the live count phone (to the Finish button at y~865) all in view. 390: headline, lede, both CTAs and scope line in view, but the artifact only starts at the very bottom edge (currency pill at y~745), so nothing at 390 backs the promise.

problems: Mobile artifact below the first screen with 28x28px stepper targets and no mobile nav (links simply hidden under 760px)
Two axe colour-contrast failures on 11.52px progress labels; colours scattered as raw hex and inline styles rather than tokens
Demo focus drops to <body> for ~1.4 s after the second signature, no path back from the sign step to fix the count, and the demo renders empty without JS

evidence.clarity: 1440 and 390: h1 'Counted by two. Written once.' followed by bold 'Tallyhall is bookkeeping for churches and small charities.' and 'Start a free 60-day trial'; roles list names Counters, Treasurer and Trustees directly under the CTA.
evidence.fit: All four trial links point to https://tallyhall.example/trial. 'For trustees' section with a ledger showing two signer names and times per Sunday; the count you sign in the hero posts into that ledger. UK/US radio switches currency, bills/notes, checks/cheques and fund name across the count, ledger and statement. Scope line 'not a payment processor and does not take online donations' sits in the hero.
evidence.distinctiveness: The hero is a counting sheet with Ann/Dev columns and a deliberately mismatched £5 line; hand-drawn SVGs of the spreadsheet, envelopes and paper sheet are captioned 'Instead of ...' to map the brief's three replacements. Self-hosted Schola/Carlito give a printed-form feel.
evidence.proof: First screen at 1440: status '£5 notes don't agree: Ann counted 9, Dev counted 8'. Typed 9, status turned green 'Both counts agree: £1,386.40', signed both, ledger row '18 Oct Ann P. 11:52 Dev M. 11:54 £1,386.40 Posted' and month total £3,747.35 (= 1,212.75 + 1,148.20 + 1,386.40). US path: $1,315.35 posted, month total $3,780.10, both correct. Statement lines sum to £1,000.00 with 45 envelopes and 1 cheque consistent.
evidence.craft: axe clean at 390 and 1440 (my own run too); no console errors or requests with network aborted; fonts are local WOFF with font-display:swap (all four loaded). Tokens for colour, a type scale (--step-*) and spacing; container queries reflow the table. Weight is ~58 KB HTML + ~120 KB fonts. Minor: og.png ships but og:image points at the absolute tallyhall.example URL; large empty band above the signature lines at 1440.
evidence.mobile: 390 and 320: 0 overflow, 0 interactive targets under 44px (steppers 44x44, labels 56x44). Sheet head, sample label and status are visible in the first 844px. Status line is position:sticky at the top of the sheet (about 14% of the viewport) so feedback stays next to the stepper you tapped; a focusin handler scrolls focused controls clear of it. Menu: 'Menu' button toggles aria-expanded, Escape closes and returns focus to the button, tapping a link closes it and scrolls.
evidence.honesty: Each artifact is labelled where it appears: 'Sample count, written for this page', 'Sample ledger, written for this page', 'Sample giving statement, written for this page'; 'Nothing here is sent anywhere; it runs on this page' beside the sign buttons. 'About 40 congregations. None of them is named here', matching the brief.
evidence.interaction: Tested: signing while lines disagree gives 'Ann can't sign yet: £5 notes don't agree'; empty gives 'No figure from Dev for £5 notes'; typed '-3' becomes 3 with 'Numbers only: anything else was taken out'; minus at 0 says 'A count can't go below zero'; 9999 gives an out-of-range message; 20-digit paste truncates to 4 by maxlength; coin '63.4.0abc' sanitises to 63.40; '.' treated as empty. Changing a line after signing clears the signature and says so; pressing a signed button takes the signature back; after posting, inputs go readOnly, buttons disabled and focus moves to 'Start the count again'. Radios work with arrow keys and have a visible ring on the label. Reduced motion: signature and ledger animations 'none', scroll-behavior auto. Minor: 'Start the count again' always resets to UK even when on US.
evidence.copy: Specific and consistent: 'Recount, correct Dev's line, then both can sign', 'The count changed after Ann signed, so the signature was cleared.', 'eight Sundays of counting to show your finance committee before anyone decides'. One awkward string: '999 is the most £5 notes one line takes on this sample.'
evidence.first_screen: 1440: promise, CTA, roles and the full operable count sheet with sample label all in one viewport. 390: headline, lede, CTA and the top of the sheet (sample label, UK/US switch, red mismatch status) are in view; the steppers and sign buttons need a scroll.

problems: 'Start the count again' always reverts to the UK sample even after switching to US (stated in the status, but surprising)
Out-of-range message wording ('999 is the most £5 notes one line takes on this sample') is clumsy
og:image references the remote tallyhall.example URL while the local og.png goes unused by the page; ~120 KB of self-hosted fonts is the main page weight

reason: B is more robust and accessible: axe-clean, every target at least 44px, a working mobile menu with Escape handling, and a demo that handles empty, negative, pasted, out-of-range, re-sign and reset paths with messages next to the control. Its sample numbers also stay consistent from the count through the ledger and statement. A is tidy but has contrast failures, 28px steppers, no mobile nav, a focus drop after signing and no edit path back from the sign step. I would only change my mind if B's local fonts or sticky status caused problems on a real low-end phone, and I saw no sign of that.
